title: IFZModPanels
blurb: A BepInEx plugin that provides a panel system for building in-game UI windows with layout, theming, persistence, and interactive controls.

reference.notes: Additive-only API. Do not version-pin the BepInDependency unless you require a specific minimum.

types.name: Panels
types.summary: Consumer entry point. Register a builder once; it re-runs on every Game-scene load.

members.signature: public static Theme DefaultTheme { get; set; }
members.returns: Theme — the default theme applied to windows that don't override. Mutable.
members.remarks: Set once during mod init. Windows that pass a theme argument to Panels.Register use that instead.

members.signature: public static void Register(string id, Action<PanelContext> build)

params.name: id
params.desc: Unique identifier for the window. Used for persistence and toggling.

params.name: build
params.desc: A builder callback that receives a PanelContext to construct the window.

members.remarks: Idempotent — same id replaces. If a Game scene is already live, builds immediately into the current canvas.
Removes the builder and destroys the window if it exists.

types.name: PanelContext
types.summary: Builder context passed to the Action<PanelContext> callback. Creates a ModWindow and returns it.

members.signature: public ModWindow Window(string title, SizeMode? size = null, Theme? theme = null, KeyCode toggleKey = KeyCode.None)

params.name: title
params.desc: Window title shown in the header.

params.name: size
params.desc: Sizing mode (AutoHeight, Fixed, Resizable). Defaults to DefaultAuto (320×400 max).

params.name: theme
params.desc: Per-window theme override. Defaults to Panels.DefaultTheme.

params.name: toggleKey
params.desc: Keyboard shortcut to show/hide the window. Defaults to None.

members.returns: ModWindow — the created window, ready for further configuration.
members.remarks: Called once during registration. The window is persisted (pos/size/collapsed/visible) via WindowStore.Load.

types.name: ModWindow
types.summary: A single in-game window with header, body, and row-based layout. Supports drag, resize, collapse, and toggle.

members.returns: bool — whether the window is locked (cannot be dragged or resized).
members.remarks: When true, DraggablePanel and ResizeGrip are disabled.

members.returns: bool — whether the body is collapsed (header only).
members.remarks: Toggling persists to disk via WindowStore.

members.returns: bool — whether the window is visible.
members.remarks: Toggling persists to disk. Hidden windows can be reopened via toggleKey.

members.returns: RectTransform — the scrollable content parent (from UiFactory.ScrollView).
members.remarks: Use this as the parent for NewRow and other layout calls.

members.returns: LabelHandle — a handle to update the label text or color.
members.remarks: Creates a new row with the label flexing to fill available width.

members.returns: LabelHandle — a handle to update the section text or color.
members.remarks: Like Label but uses Accent color and Bold style.

members.signature: public ValueRow Value(string label, string initial = "")
members.returns: ValueRow — a handle to update the value text or color.
members.remarks: Creates a two-column row: label on left, value on right.
Creates a new row with a faint separator line.

members.signature: public BarHandle Bar(string label = null, float value01 = 0f)
members.returns: BarHandle — a handle to update fill, color, or label.
members.remarks: Creates a track with an Accent-colored fill bar.

members.signature: public ButtonHandle Button(string text, Action onClick)
members.returns: ButtonHandle — a handle to update interactability or label.
members.remarks: Creates a 120px-wide button row.

members.signature: public ButtonHandle IconButton(IconKind icon, Action onClick)
members.returns: ButtonHandle — a handle to update interactability.
members.remarks: Creates a square icon button (size = RowHeight).

members.signature: public SliderHandle Slider(string label, float min, float max, Action<float> onChange)
members.returns: SliderHandle — a handle to get/set the slider value.
members.remarks: Creates a horizontal slider with optional label.

members.signature: public ToggleHandle Toggle(string label, bool initial, Action<bool> onChange)
members.returns: ToggleHandle — a handle to get/set the toggle state.
members.remarks: Creates a checkbox-style toggle with an Accent-colored check indicator.

members.signature: public InputHandle Input(string placeholder, Action<string> onChange)
members.returns: InputHandle — a handle to get/set the input text.
members.remarks: Creates a TMP_InputField with placeholder.

members.returns: ListRegion — a vertical container for ListRow items.
members.remarks: Creates a scrollable list with automatic height fitting.

members.signature: public GraphHandle Graph(GraphKind kind, float height = 80f)
members.returns: GraphHandle — a handle to push/set graph values.
members.remarks: Creates a graph with an inset from the background.
Called every Tick. Use sparingly.

members.signature: public void Every(float seconds, Action cb)
members.remarks: Called every N seconds. Use for periodic updates.

types.name: ListRegion
types.summary: A vertical container for ListRow items. Created by ModWindow.List().

members.remarks: Destroys all child row GameObjects.

members.returns: ListRow — a new row inside this list.
members.remarks: Creates a new row with the region's theme.

types.name: ListRow
types.summary: A horizontal row inside a ListRegion. Created by ListRegion.Row().

members.returns: LabelHandle — a handle to update the label.
members.remarks: Creates a label that flexes to fill available width.

members.returns: BarHandle — a handle to update fill or color.
members.remarks: Creates a bar with the region's theme colors.

members.signature: public ButtonHandle Button(string s, Action onClick)
members.returns: ButtonHandle — a handle to update interactability or label.
members.remarks: Creates a 70px-wide button.
Sizes the icon to RowHeight.

types.name: Theme
types.summary: A color and layout configuration applied to windows and their elements.

members.returns: Color — accent color for fills, checks, graphs.

members.remarks: Default: Color.white

members.returns: float — padding in pixels for corners.
members.remarks: Default: 8f
Default: 26f
Default: 28f

members.returns: TMP_FontAsset — font (null resolves to game default).
members.remarks: null -> UiFactory resolves the game's default TMP font.

public static SizeMode AutoHeight(float width, float maxHeight)
public static SizeMode Fixed(float width, float height)
public static SizeMode Resizable(float width, float height, Vector2 min, Vector2 max)

members.remarks: AutoHeight(320f, 400f).

types.name: IconKind
types.summary: Icon types rendered by IconGraphic.

types.name: IconGraphic
types.summary: A MaskableGraphic that draws icons (play, pause, prev, next, shuffle, list, lock, disc) as vector shapes.

members.remarks: Changes the icon shape. Triggers a vertex rebuild.

types.summary: Graph types rendered by GraphGraphic.

types.summary: A MaskableGraphic that draws line or bar graphs from a list of float values.

members.remarks: Line or Bar. Default: Line.
Values to graph. Add/remove and call MarkDirty().
Y-axis minimum (used when AutoRange is false).
Y-axis maximum (used when AutoRange is false).
When true, auto-scales Y to data range. Default: true.
Thickness of line segments. Default: 2f.
Calls SetVerticesDirty() to schedule a mesh rebuild.

types.name: GraphHandle
types.summary: Handle to update graph values, range, and color.

members.remarks: Replaces all values and marks dirty.

members.signature: public void Push(float value, int maxPoints = 120)

params.name: maxPoints
params.desc: Maximum points to keep (default 120). Evicts oldest.

members.remarks: Appends a value and evicts oldest if over maxPoints.

members.signature: public void SetRange(float min, float max)
members.remarks: Disables AutoRange and sets fixed range.

types.name: ResizeGrip
types.summary: Bottom-right drag grip that resizes Target within [Min, Max]. Fires Resized on end-drag.

members.remarks: The window to resize.
Minimum size (default 160×80).
Maximum size (default 900×900).
Fired on end-drag with the new size.

types.name: PointerHold
types.summary: Tracks whether a pointer is held (down/up). Implements IPointerDownHandler, IPointerUpHandler.

members.returns: bool — true while pointer is held.
members.remarks: Reset to false on OnDisable.

types.name: HoverTooltip
types.summary: Shows/hides a Tooltip GameObject on pointer enter/exit.

members.remarks: The tooltip to show/hide.

types.name: DraggablePanel

members.remarks: When true, dragging is disabled.
Fired on end-drag with the new anchored position.
The panel to drag.

types.name: CameraZoomHoverBlocker
types.summary: Blocks camera zoom movement while pointer hovers over the panel. Implements IPointerEnterHandler, IPointerExitHandler.

types.name: WindowStore
types.summary: Persists window state (position, size, collapsed, visible) to a JSON file under the DLL directory.

members.remarks: Applies saved state (pos/size/collapsed/visible). No-op until a window is registered.
Persists current state to disk. Called automatically by ModWindow on move/resize/collapse.

types.summary: Serializable snapshot of a window's state for persistence.

members.remarks: Window identifier.
X position.
Y position.
Width.
Height.
Default: true.
True once user resized / fixed size stored.
